Cooperative Election Study (CES)

A large online survey of U.S. adults about elections and politics, run by YouGov since 2006 (as the CCES until 2020), with a common-content file per year and a cumulative file that harmonizes the years.

What the sources say: each Dataverse dataset used here (Cumulative CES Common Content, doi:10.7910/DVN/II2DB6, and the Common Content of 2020, 2022 and 2024, doi:10.7910/DVN/E9N6PH, PR4L8P and X11EP6) shows the license "CC0 1.0" in its Dataverse metadata, with no custom terms of use. The cumulative file's build code (github.com/kuriwaki/cces_cumulative) has no license file; this repo reads it for the variable mapping and doesn't redistribute it.

year — The year of the study. A cumulative-file row's wave is its `year`.
